title: terraform(private): refactor GPU node pools, IAM roles, and networking state layout
author: Ava Moreno
release_notes: Refactor private Terraform modules: GPU node pools and IAM roles now use stable module inputs and separate state layout for networking. Requires state migration for existing Private installs; documented in state/README.md.
description: Motivation: private deployments have diverged in state layout between GPU node pools, IAM roles, and networking modules which made upgrades brittle across on-prem and VPC installs. This PR refactors the modules to: 1) separate networking state into a dedicated statefile/state layout to allow independent upgrades, 2) normalize GPU node pool inputs and enable flexible existing-instance imports, 3) centralize IAM role creation with least-privilege templates and stable role naming to avoid drift during rollouts. Changes include state migration helpers and an upgrade guide. Checklist: - [x] refactor modules/gke/gpu_nodes.tf and variables - [x] split modules/network into network/ and route/ submodules with state README - [x] centralize modules/iam into roles.tf and templates - [x] add state migration scripts and docs - [x] update examples/private and tests - [x] CI passes (reran integration once to address transient apply failures). This is a breaking change for existing Private customers using the previous monolithic state layout; follow state/README.md for the migration steps. Related: ENG-7345, SUP-1921.
commits: a3c9f2b: refactor(gke): extract gpu node pool module and normalize inputs
f1d2e7a: feat(iam): consolidate role templates and stable naming
b7c4a1e: refactor(network): split vpc/route modules and update state layout

review_conversation: Ravi Patel (reviewer): Can we avoid changing the role names in-place? This will force a replace on existing infra. Response: Yes — added stable name logic and a migration import helper documented in state/README.md.

Sofia Lund (reviewer): The split state looks good, but will we support rolling upgrades across multiple clusters? Response: Added import scripts and an example in examples/private/upgrade.sh showing rolling import per-cluster.
Miguel Torres (approver): Confirmed CI pass and manual smoke on a staging private cluster. Approved and requested squash merge.
Author (Ava Moreno): Addressed feedback and added tests for import idempotency; CI rerun fixed flaky integration apply by pinning provider versions.
Ops note (from SUP-1921): We need an upgrade plan doc for customers on older versions; added migration checklist to state/README.md.
